description: The man wears a rust-brown wool tunic reaching to the knees, with narrow gold-brown woven trim at the V-shaped front opening, cuffs and hem. A cream linen underlayer shows at the collar and below the outer sleeves, with small buttons down the upper chest. A broad dark leather belt has a plain rectangular brass buckle, small decorative fittings and a hanging strap. Olive-brown fitted trousers extend down into soft dark brown leather boots. The garment has a modest woven surface texture and no heavy ornament or armor. His head and both hands remain uncovered.
